title: Conclude request followed by standalone confirmed-error analogue
purpose: Differentiate later-session MMS tag handling by providing a conclude request and a separate confirmed-error entry message, broadening PDU-tag coverage beyond confirmed requests.
expected_behavior: The first message exercises the Conclude-Request-PDU parser path after normal framing; the second independently covers the Confirmed-Error-PDU tag entry path. Both should be handled as framed parser inputs without crash.
constraints_preserved: Each TPKT-framed message starts with version 0x03
First message TPKT total-length matches full message length 0x0017
Second message TPKT total-length matches full message length 0x000c
MMS PDU tags 0xAB and 0xA2 follow the supplied MMS PDU type catalog
No exact historical issue 589 COTP payload is reused
Messages are structurally distinct from the other seeds and not cosmetic variants
issue_safety_notes: The conclude message keeps a benign CR framing shape with a safe TPDU-size code; the standalone confirmed-error analogue omits risky COTP parameters entirely. No malformed exponent or negative-size motif is included.
